details: Design: a taken item's problem is written as a separate review (Q1, stamped at the take sha) beside the real review (later sha), and the check recorder, `relay queue done` and the merge guard each re-check the same facts with their own rules. Closing core-tests-not-in-gate (23 Oct) was refused three times with nothing wrong, needed a second checker run, and the Q1 verdict was never stored on master. Owner chose one redesign over three patches ("a").
failing_case: (1) A check over the take file (reviewed 4522dcb, Q1) and the whole-change review (reviewed 54c5dca, F1-F3) is refused at lib/relay_verdict.py:550; Q1 goes to the notes and `done` refuses. (2) `done --test tests/test_ci_hook_tests.py::HookTestsStep::test_quick_runs_the_free_core_tests` passes (lib/relay_queue.py:791 checks the last `::` part) and the merge guard refuses it (plugins/core/hooks/merge.py:149 literal substring). (3) A docs/handover.md commit after the check makes `done` refuse (lib/relay_queue.py:755) while the gate and the delegate skill treat the handover as inert. (4) After the merge, master holds no Q1 findings and no Q1 verdict for the closed item.
pass_cases: Take, build, gate, one review, fix, gate, ONE checker run, done, merge: no refusal; master holds the item's problem, every finding's verdict and the gate log in one record; a test name or a later file is judged the same by done and by the merge guard (one function, tested from both callers).
reason: tests/test_check_record.py:446 TestEndToEnd end-to-end (one check, done, merge guard, master holds Q1 verdict and gate log); tests/test_check_record.py:351 one function for test name; :327 handover after check accepted. Failed at base, pass at head.
findings.summary: Checks keep two finding lists and three rule sets
